name: ds4
description: DeepSeek 4 Flash and PRO local inference engine for Metal, CUDA and ROCm
one_liner: Software that lets a capable AI language model run directly on your own Mac or PC hardware instead of through a paid cloud API, specialized for a small set of top open models.
buyer: A company handling sensitive data (legal, healthcare, finance) that needs a capable AI model running on hardware they own, not sent to a third-party cloud API.
business_use_cases: A law firm or healthcare provider runs it on owned hardware to get AI assistance without ever sending client data to an external API.
A hardware reseller builds and sells pre-configured 'local AI workstation' machines (Mac Studios, DGX Spark boxes) tuned around it.
An AI infra consultant offers setup and tuning services for companies wanting multi-GPU local inference instead of ongoing API costs.

money_ideas.idea: Sell pre-built, pre-tuned local-inference hardware bundles (Mac Studio or multi-GPU rigs) targeted at privacy-sensitive buyers.
Offer a managed on-prem AI setup and maintenance retainer for regulated industries that can't use cloud AI APIs.

steal_this: This weekend, package a turnkey 'private AI in a box' offer for one regulated-industry client: a tuned machine plus setup, positioned against cloud AI's data-privacy risk.
